item.description:

Institution: Univ. MODENA e R. E., Modena
Field: Biology / 05/BIOS-06 Fisiologia

The project aims to investigate the role of extracellular vesicles (EVs) in neuron–microglia communication during the early stages of Alzheimer’s disease. The candidate will isolate EVs from mouse brain tissue and assess their effects on primary neural and glial cultures. The cultures will be examined using immunofluorescence, mitochondrial activity assays, and western blotting. EVs will also be administered to healthy animals to investigate their effects on neuroinflammation in vivo. Specifically, microglial and astrocytic activation will be assessed by immunofluorescence, while inflammatory marker expression will be evaluated using western blotting and cytokine assays.
